scheduler_signal.summary: Revised the same bounded experiment into eight explicit executions, with each tightened run bound to one physical parent. Objective selection is unchanged by this revision: both current objectives remain necessary and jointly cover the two mandatory observables, while the overall mechanism-separation objective remains only partly closed. The historical project used a different experiment key, so its initialization and qualification are not inherited; no results or analysis were supplied for this exact plan.

current_objectives: Determine whether changing only the constant effective surface concentration between the two exact Table I anchors accounts for at least half of the supported material contrast while holding the material-specific constant-D anchor, thermal history, equation, initial condition, and reduction fixed.

Determine whether the apparent qualified tail and material contrast change materially when rows at or below 3 x 10^15 cm^-3 and shared-support rows are handled by the preregistered admissibility and weighting rules.
frozen_invariants: Use both mandatory observables from objective.fig4_mechanism_discrimination: the two legend-bound Zn concentration-depth profiles and their supported front/tail contrast. Never use the paper fit overlay as observations or infer behavior across the 235-pixel InAlAs gap.
Temperature is exactly 480 degrees C and elapsed diffusion time is exactly 480 s in every physical case; no other temperature, time, layer stack, source history, or device process is introduced.

For material m, solve the bounded phenomenological family partial C_m/partial t = D_m partial^2 C_m/partial x^2 for 0<x<L and 0<t<=480 s, with C_m(x,0)=0, C_m(0,t)=Cs, and C_m(L,t)=0. Use D_Al=1.59 x 10^-12 cm^2/s and D_Ga=1.05 x 10^-12 cm^2/s only as the supplied Table I comparison anchors.

Set L deterministically to x_max + 6 sqrt(D_max t), where x_max is the deepest existing supplied target depth, D_max=1.59 x 10^-12 cm^2/s, and t=480 s. This fixes the remote boundary from declared inputs without fitting it; report L in the case ledger.

The only physical intervention is Cs at one of the two exact supplied anchors: 6.85 x 10^19 or 8.35 x 10^19 cm^-3. The complete 2 material x 2 boundary factorial is evaluated; no interpolation, optimization, widening, time-dependent source, extra channel, fitted exponent, or defect identity is allowed.

Freeze four reductions. M0 primary-direct selects support_class=direct_pixel and observed central C>3 x 10^15 cm^-3 and assigns each selected row weight 1. M1 grouped-primary uses the same rows but groups equal source-pixel or explicit provenance identifiers and assigns every row in group g weight 1/n_g, so each group totals one. M2 shared-inclusive selects every direct_pixel or shared_support row with C>3 x 10^15 cm^-3 and uses weight 1/n_g. M3 sub-limit-inclusive selects every direct_pixel or shared_support row regardless of C and uses weight 1/n_g. Rows lacking any required support class, concentration, depth, bound, or group identifier are unusable for the affected reduction; they are never reassigned or imputed.

Preserve every existing point index, series identity, concentration/depth bound, gap, and support label. Sample simulated log10 concentration only at existing target depths by monotone interpolation on the solver mesh; never create a target row or bridge a missing interval.

For row i use y_i=log10(C_i/cm^-3), residual r_i=yhat_i-y_i, concentration half-width u_C,i equal to the larger supplied log bound, and u_i^2=u_C,i^2+(abs(dyhat/dx)u_x,i)^2+u_num,i^2. The unique tightened child of that physical case supplies u_num,i=abs(yhat_tight,i-yhat_primary,i) at the identical row. A missing or mismatched parent-child row makes that row and all derived quantities requiring it unavailable.

For set A compute WRMSE_log=sqrt(sum(w_i r_i^2)/sum(w_i)), Q=sum(w_i(r_i/u_i)^2), weighted in-band fraction=sum(w_i I(abs(r_i)<=u_i))/sum(w_i), and effective count equal to the number of dependence groups. Report all metrics separately by material, primary/tail segment, and sensitivity mask.

For each reduction and material, define front depth F as the unique monotone downward crossing of 5.4 x 10^16 cm^-3 bracketed by adjacent selected rows in one contiguous support interval. Define tail extent E=x_end-F, where x_end is the deepest selected row in that same interval with observed C>3 x 10^15 cm^-3 for M0-M2 and observed C present for M3. Set E=0 only when F exists and no later selected row meets that reduction's end predicate; if F is absent, multiple, crosses a gap, or the interval has fewer than five dependence groups, set F and E missing. Qualified dose is the trapezoidal integral only from F to x_end in that interval; never bridge a gap.

Freeze contrast scaling from the M1 own-anchor reduction and reuse it for every anchor and mask: s_F is the propagated one-standard-deviation uncertainty of the own-anchor between-material front difference and s_Z is that of the own-anchor between-material difference in Z=log10(qualified dose/(cm^-2)); both must be finite and >0. For anchor a, d_a=(F_Al,a-F_Ga,a, Z_Al,a-Z_Ga,a) and Delta_a=sqrt((d_F/s_F)^2+(d_Z/s_Z)^2). If either scale or component is unavailable, the contrast and all dependent decisions are inconclusive.

Propagate uncertainty deterministically by treating every dependence group as one latent perturbation: define u_evid,i^2=u_C,i^2+(abs(dyhat/dx)u_x,i)^2, shift all rows in group g coherently to their +u_evid,i and -u_evid,i endpoints, recompute [F,Z], and use half the endpoint difference as that group's sensitivity vector. Sum outer products over unique groups once, add each case's paired u_num contribution once as an independent numerical term, retain cross-material covariance when a group identifier is shared, and apply the delta method to Delta. Compute R=1-max(Delta_common_low,Delta_common_high)/Delta_own and its standard error from the same covariance and analytic gradients; if the common contrasts tie within 1e-12 use the larger branch variance. Report the untruncated 95% interval estimate plus or minus 1.96 standard errors. If Delta_own<=max(1e-6,1.96 times its standard error), division is degenerate and R is inconclusive.

For each M1-M3 sensitivity relative to M0, compute relative change for E and Delta as abs(v_k-v_0)/max(abs(v_0),1e-12), using the M0 units for the fixed 1e-12 denominator. A missing value yields inconclusive rather than a numeric change. The artifact category is supported if any available change is >=0.50 or the boundary category changes; rejected only if every required change is <=0.10, propagated 95% intervals for nonzero contrasts exclude zero, and no category changes; otherwise it is inconclusive.

No output from this study establishes kick-out, VCD, or another microscopic mechanism. The two-regime and continuous-response hypotheses remain deferred until the present boundary and evidence-support gates are resolved.

prediction_tests.expected_result: Both common-boundary comparisons reduce the standardized material contrast so that the lower 95% bound of R is at least 0.50, each material's own-anchor WRMSE_log is at most 0.15 decade, and changing Cs moves dose and front depth coherently in both materials.
prediction_tests.falsifying_result: Reject the bounded surface-control hypothesis if the upper 95% bound of R is at most 0.25, or if either material's own-anchor case fails WRMSE_log <=0.15 decade, or if the Cs intervention moves dose/front in opposite directions between materials after numerical checks pass. Values between the 0.25 and 0.50 gates are inconclusive.
prediction_tests.observable: Boundary-collapse fraction R from own-anchor versus common-low and common-high material contrasts, plus per-material whole-profile adequacy.

prediction_tests.expected_result: Support the evidence-artifact concern when admissibility changes reduce tail extent or material contrast by at least 50%, or change the boundary decision category; this limits mechanism claims but does not claim that the samples lack physical low-concentration Zn.
prediction_tests.falsifying_result: Reject the bounded artifact hypothesis when all admissibility variants change both tail extent and contrast by at most 10%, their propagated intervals remain separated from zero, and no decision category changes. Changes greater than 10% but less than 50% are inconclusive.
prediction_tests.observable: Relative change in supported tail extent and material-contrast statistic under primary direct-pixel, shared-group, shared-inclusive, and sub-limit-inclusive reductions.

resource_estimate.runtime_basis: Exactly four primary one-dimensional physical cells and four paired tightened reruns; all profile, boundary-collapse, uncertainty, shared-support, and detection-limit reductions reuse those eight raw outputs. Historical progress shows an older SProcess project was materialized and initialized, but the current execution context does not declare the capabilities needed for this new model, so resource feasibility remains conditional on a fresh domain review and initialization within the declared R-2020.09 backend.

stop_conditions: Stop before implementation if a registered Sentaurus R-2020.09 domain review cannot confirm the custom concentration state, equation, boundaries, clean case reset, or raw profile output; do not infer support from the backend name or historical qualification.

For each reduction, stop only that reduction if either mandatory profile, exact series identity, point indices, concentration/depth bounds, support class, shared-group ownership, or detection-limit provenance required by its row predicate is unavailable; do not infer missing metadata. Stop the overall claim only if M0, M1, or a quantity required by both selected hypotheses is unavailable.

Stop and report numerical inconclusive if any of the eight executions fails, produces a nonpositive or nonfinite primary prediction, omits an existing primary row, exceeds 0.05-decade paired convergence change, or changes the decision category when tightened.
Stop the physical comparison if either own-anchor material fails WRMSE_log <=0.15 decade; a contrast change from an inadequate base model cannot support boundary dominance.

Report surface boundary control rejected when the upper 95% bound of R is <=0.25, supported within this bounded phenomenology when the lower 95% bound is >=0.50 and all gates pass, and inconclusive otherwise.

Report tail support artifact supported when an admissibility variant changes tail extent or contrast by >=50% or changes the decision category, rejected when every change is <=10% with stable intervals, and inconclusive otherwise.

Stop as evidence-limited if a required front crossing or dose interval would bridge the InAlAs gap, depend on a row at or below 3 x 10^15 cm^-3, or leave fewer than five direct-pixel dependence groups in a claimed segment.
Do not add a surface-history parameter, optimize D or Cs, widen the two-anchor intervention, add a diffusion channel, or proceed to the deferred continuous/two-regime comparison in this experiment.
Stop after the finite factorial yields one supported, rejected, or inconclusive bounded disposition for each selected hypothesis; do not state a final microscopic mechanism.

value_assessment.rationale: Current coverage and objective selection are unchanged: both original target observables are used by the four-cell surface-boundary factorial and by the evidence-support sensitivity, and both current objectives remain the exact selected subset. The overall objective remains only partly closed because this experiment can classify a bounded boundary explanation and tail admissibility but cannot select kick-out/VCD or the continuous-response alternative. Those objectives remain deferred until boundary dominance is rejected or ambiguous and the above-limit direct-pixel tail is stable, after which a separately reviewed finite model family is required. Their deferral does not undermine validity or identifiability of the present within-model Cs contrast because material-specific D, time, equation, initial condition, and reduction are frozen, but it restricts allowed claims to boundary-anchor sensitivity and evidence robustness within the constant-D phenomenology. The revision is minimal: the same four physical cells are retained, four already required tightened executions are now explicit, and deterministic reductions and checks add no solver work or free parameter. Evidence support and discrimination remain medium because digitization, the InAlAs gap, shared pixels, approximate detection limit, and absent qualified raw rows can still force an evidence-limited outcome. Feasibility remains conditional on a fresh domain review and initialization because the execution context names SProcess R-2020.09 without capability statements and the differently keyed old project is not inherited.

review_request.instruction: 独立审查完整计划与确切总体目标及绑定进展的匹配度，重点判断当前最小任务是否科学上有意义、是否足够明确可实现、后续目标和条件是否保留。逐项检查实际案例数量与复算绑定、固定方程和输入的来源/角色、支持区间与不确定度、控制及评价定义是否足够确定；区分由实现者合理选择的工程数值设置和尚待科学选择的参数。检查实现、初始化、独立审查和执行之间的前提是否可满足，是否存在让尚无成果的步骤互相等待的循环。执行上下文缺少能力细节时要准确限定可确认范围，不把历史项目初始化当新方案资格。未覆盖所有总体目标本身不决定拒绝；根据遗漏是否影响本轮有效性给出理由。不得自行改计划或继承旧审查，任何通过或修订均须有确切依据。 本次 experiment_results 绑定的是已经批准的原论文图证逐行参考表，用于核对支持条件；它们不是新 TCAD 结果。result_analysis 绑定同一图证的独立审查与确定性报告，用于理解已有资格范围和检出限冲突。请实际核对计划的行选择、支持分类、组标识、区间与阈值规则能否应用于这些原件，不替换或补造缺失字段；检查各假设的判定和验证门是否正确限定影响范围，失败、拒绝假设和结果不确定能否被如实表达。确认当前目标与正式观测量、案例和检查有明确对应，而不只在理由中提及。新增这些参考输入只用于这次审查，不改变已封存计划，不继承其先前审查。
